lede: The most consequential meeting this week is San Miguel County's Planning Commission on November 12, where proposed changes to the Affordable Housing Impact Mitigation Fee — a key lever in whether workforce housing actually gets built here — are on the table alongside broader housing incentive ideas. TMVOA also kicks off its three-meeting 2027 budget cycle on November 6, and the regional intergovernmental session on November 9 brings all five jurisdictions together for a cross-entity check-in on large projects and infrastructure pressures.

notable.stake: Proposed fee changes could reshape how workforce housing gets built countywide.
